messages:
ana: FYI I ran the onboarding microbench for tern-int6 against our temporal-split holdout (historical vs recent month) and saw a clear regression only on the recent slice at R@10. posting the run and quick artifacts.
ana: command:
```
./embed_temporal_bench --model=tern-int6 --holdout=temporal_4k --split=historical,recent --k=1,5,10 --quant=per-tensor --whiten=trained_on_history
```
colin: paste the numbers? keep it short please.
ana: table (avg 3 seeds):
```
model       slice       R@1    R@5    R@10
tern-fp16   historical  0.429  0.734  0.792
tern-int6   historical  0.422  0.728  0.786
tern-fp16   recent      0.441  0.748  0.803
tern-int6   recent      0.436  0.690  0.684  <-- large R@10 drop on recent
```
mika: whoa R@10 collapse on recent but historical ok. that screams distribution shift in recent data interacting with quant noise. any preprocessing differences for recent docs?
ana: pipeline identical. note: whitening was trained only on historical dev set (we've historically excluded "recent" from whitening to avoid leaking).
colin: leakage concern aside, if the model will serve recent content, whitening should represent expected runtime distribution. can you check embedding L2 stats and token coverage diffs?
ana: L2 stats by slice:
```
metric    model      slice      mean_norm  std_norm
L2        tern-fp16  recent     12.2       2.0
L2        tern-int6  recent     11.7       4.1   <-- heavy tail on recent
L2        tern-fp16  historical12.3       1.9
L2        tern-int6  historical12.2       2.1
```
mika: heavy std only on recent+int6. token coverage? any new tokens/product names in recent slice?
ana: yes our product team shipped two new feature names last month; rare tokens show up in recent data. frequency skew obvious in token histograms.
colin: likely two interacting issues: whitening matrix not representative for new tokens and per-tensor quant calibration under-samples new low-freq embeddings -> scale dominated by historical mass. try: (A) whitening retrain including a time-aware sample (include recent), (B) stratified calibration that upweights low-freq/new-token embeddings, (C) per-channel quant. small AB tests.
bench-bot: kicked runs 6367894520 (zh-whiten include recent), 6367894550 (strat-calib), 6367894580 (per-channel).
bench-bot: run 6367894520 finished: tern-int6 with time-aware whiten -> recent R@10 = 0.749 (partial recovery). logs: /artifacts/6367894520/meta.json
bench-bot: run 6367894550 finished: tern-int6 stratified-calib -> recent R@10 = 0.772. logs: /artifacts/6367894550/meta.json
bench-bot: run 6367894580 finished: tern-int6 per-channel -> recent R@10 = 0.796 (near fp16). logs: /artifacts/6367894580/meta.json
mika: per-channel + time-aware whitening looks best. stratified calib helps a lot too. can you paste norm stats after per-channel run?
ana: post per-channel stats:
```
metric    model      slice      mean_norm  std_norm
L2        tern-int6  recent     12.1       2.2
```
colin: std back to normal. root cause confirmed: evolving token distribution (recent) + whitening trained on old data + coarse per-tensor quant -> outlier tail and neighborhood swaps for R@10.
mika: recommended immediate actions for onboarding: (1) require a temporal-slice check for "recent" data when onboarding models that serve live content, (2) whitelist per-channel quant for models exposed to fast-evolving vocab, (3) add stratified calibration recipe that samples recent/rare tokens heavier, (4) add nightly canary that computes per-slice R@10 and fails if recent drop > 0.03 vs baseline.
colin: please open PR to update the onboarding checklist and add bench flags (--temporal-split, --strat-calib, --perchannel). also add a short note in the model-card recommending refresh cadence for whitening when product introduces new token classes.
ana: will open PR and file ticket EMBED-ONB-4020 with artifacts and UMAP snapshots.
ops-bot: EMBED-ONB-4020 created and assigned to ana; artifacts: /artifacts/6367894*
mika: one more heuristic idea: compute per-token embedding drift over time (mean embedding change for tokens appearing in both historical and recent). if drift > threshold, trigger whitening refresh. add to backlog.
colin: +1. summary looks good. thanks folks :thumbsup:
ana: thanks team, closing loop.
